build_adm_unet: build a conditional ADM U-Net diffusion model using the adm_unet factory function with CLIP image embeddings
create_admunet_instance: create an ADMUNet instance with custom channels per layer, residual blocks, and attention configuration
run_admunet_forward: run the ADMUNet forward pass with a noised input tensor, timestep, and optional conditional inputs
create_admstack: create an ADMStack container to stack residual blocks, attention blocks, and simple blocks together
build_adm_stack_res_attn: build an ADM stack with a residual block followed by an attention block using adm_stack_res_attn
